articles.summary: Investor's Business Daily: CrowdStrike To Acquire Identity Security Firm Amid Cybersecurity Platform Race. CrowdStrike announced the acquisition of identity security firm SGNL in a deal valued at about $740 million. CrowdStrike stock dipped on news. Related tickers mentioned: CRWD, CYBR, MSFT, PANW, ZS.
